#### Legendary Bioflux Factory

**Output:**
- ~20 Legendary Bioflux / Minute
- Seeds and Spoilage

**Input:**
- Stacked belt of Jellynuts
- 2 Stacked belts of Yumako

**To Use the Factory:**
- Make sure the inputs are connected
- Put some spoilage in the requester chest
- Take care of the spoilage and the seeds

**Update 11/8/2025:**
- Several bug fixes
